state.study: Exploratory semantic design probes. Synthetic descriptions only. No rendered images or human outcome measurements. Each question is independent.

symmetry_compare_v0.instructions: Scenario: Two alternatives deserve equal attention and must be compared using the same fields. Which conclusion or design direction is best supported for the stated task? Judge the supplied descriptions, not the option letters. Use insufficient evidence when a preference requires missing information; use no relevant difference only when equivalence is established.

criteria.A: Use equal visual weight and aligned fields.
criteria.B: Give one alternative much more visual weight without a stated reason.
criteria.U: The supplied evidence is insufficient to prefer either proposal.
criteria.I: The supplied evidence establishes no relevant difference between the proposals.
